vision: Create an easy macOS task-management tool that remains accessible as an overlay and can be updated through hotkey-triggered voice commands.
goals: Let users manage tasks without leaving their current app.
Convert natural-language dictation into task operations.
Support add, complete, and modify flows with minimal friction.
Eventually support all UN official languages (Arabic, Chinese, English, French, Russian, Spanish).

milestones.title: Capture voice input after global hotkey
Apply checklist updates safely and predictably
Add multilingual support for UN official languages

use_cases.title: Voice-driven list mutation from any app
input_tasks: Send a passport scan to HR chat
use_cases.voice_input: I've sent a passport scan. I need to schedule a meeting with Orlando and start the laundry.
use_cases.notes: Exact wording may vary; intent should be preserved.

decisions.context: Need a persistent task-management interaction while users work in other apps.
decisions.decision: Use overlay UI plus hotkey-triggered voice updates.
decisions.consequences: Requires macOS global hotkey handling, accessibility and microphone permissions, and robust intent parsing.

decisions.context: Long-term product accessibility should cover globally used official UN languages.
decisions.decision: Plan support for Arabic, Chinese, English, French, Russian, and Spanish after core English-like flow is stable.
decisions.consequences: Needs locale-aware transcription, intent normalization, and multilingual QA.
